fields.label: Group Reporting Currency
fields.description: Must be a group reporting currency; cross rates are derived.

fields.label: Quoted Per
fields.description: How many units of the from-currency the quote is for: JPY per 100, KRW per 1,000, IDR and VND per 10,000. The direction never changes.

fields.label: Average Quote
fields.description: Statutory sheets: translates the P&L, per Quoted Per units of the from-currency.

fields.label: Closing Quote
fields.description: Statutory sheets: translates the balance sheet, per Quoted Per units of the from-currency.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Constant sheets: the one rate for both average and closing (QA-1), per Quoted Per units of the from-currency.

fields.label: Rate As Quoted
fields.description: The quote as entered, with its unit. Set on save.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Manual: entered by a person. ERP pre-fill: proposed from the ERP feed. Duplicated: proposed from a previous sheet. Migrated: carried over from a Group Exchange Rate. Editing a quote makes the row Manual.

fields.label: ERP Average Quote
fields.description: What the ERP feed quoted when pre-filled. Reference only.

fields.label: ERP Closing Quote
fields.description: What the ERP feed quoted when pre-filled. Reference only.

fields.label: Legacy Documents
fields.description: The Group Exchange Rate documents this row was migrated from.
